text: The purpose of this report is to appoint and remove directors from the Wexford Heights BIA board of management.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominee to the Business Improvement Area (BIA) board of management set out below at the pleasure of Scarborough Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Wexford Heights: Dickins Demers, Deanna 2. Removed the following director from the Business Improvement Area (BIA) board of management set out below: Wexford Heights: Bassett, Sandra
